title: Patch locally normal finite intermediate algebras
statement: Let A be a Noetherian integral domain [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] with fraction field K. Suppose there is a nonzero f in A such that every prime localization of A_f is a normal domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring, def-weil-ring-localization-away, def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Suppose also that for every maximal ideal m of A there is a finite A-subalgebra C of K [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], contained in integralClosure A K [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure], whose prime localizations at primes contracting to m are integrally closed. Then there is a finite A-subalgebra B of K contained in integralClosure A K for which every prime localization B_q is integrally closed.

proof.text: Apply the compactness extraction theorem to obtain a finite family and its supremum with normal localizations.
Apply the finite supremum patching theorem to this family, preserving containment, finiteness and local normality.
